ksbs.description: The fundamentals of HV technologies, including chassis design, engines, fuels, transmissions, 12/24V electrical systems, air-conditioning, hydraulic and air braking, and air suspension.
The types and associated characteristics of heavy vehicles, their configurations and applications.
Diagnostic principles and logical problem-solving techniques related to heavy vehicles.
Sufficient health and safety knowledge and environmental awareness to carry out work safely.
Operator's Licence requirements relating to heavy vehicles.

How to service, inspect and maintain vehicles and trailers to expected standards, and the importance of safety inspection and maintenance schedules in meeting Operator's Licence and legal obligations.
Customer expectations and the implications of work carried out.
The need to be reliable, flexible, diligent and a good timekeeper.
How the business works operationally, including commercial and financial awareness in the heavy vehicle industry.
Complex problem-solving techniques.
The requirements of providing roadside assistance.
Carry out basic tasks with tools and equipment common to mechanical and electrical heavy vehicle procedures.
Keep up to date with emerging technologies within the heavy vehicle industry.
Contribute to a safe and efficient workshop and follow company and legislative processes.
Access specific and related heavy vehicle technical information appropriately.
Service, inspect and maintain heavy vehicles and trailers to company, DVSA and manufacturer standards.
Use diagnostic and electrical measuring equipment to identify faults and underlying causes on heavy vehicles.
Inspect and prepare vehicles and trailers to meet DVSA standards prescribed in the tester's manual.
Carry out final quality checks before customer handover without supervision.
Apply advanced diagnostic principles and logical problem-solving techniques and regimes.
Maintain records to company and Operator's Licence obligations and regulation.
Communicate effectively in writing and orally, internally and with customers, on heavy vehicle inspection and diagnostic topics.
Act in line with company values, treat customers and stakeholders courteously, and respond promptly to provide an excellent experience.
Work effectively as a team member, take ownership and responsibility, and remain honest and accountable when things do not go to plan.
Commit to continuous development of self, team and processes.
